originals.citation: Luthar, S. S., Cushing, G., et al. (1998). Multiple jeopardy: Risk and protective factors among addicted mothers' offspring. Development and Psychopathology.

quote: We have completed such a study, which we compare to a similar study independently conducted in 1998.
notes: Replication by comparison of two independently conducted studies; the title mirrors Luthar et al. 1998 ('Risk and protective factors among addicted mothers' offspring'), the independent 1998 study. @nunes1998 is the authors' own related study, not the target. Full text not accessible.
